rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: AROlical
Exhibition name: Blue Ribbon
rows.Origin: Bred by Jack E. Christensen (United States, 1984).
rows.Bloom: Lavender. Strong, fruity, sweet fragrance. 35 to 40 petals. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Breeder's notes: Lavender Hybrid Tea, very fragrant, large flowers. Moderate growth; low to moderate height. (as per JC's website).
